race.comment: LA LA LILLY (5) looks the one to beat off a good debut in the G3 Maribyrnong Plate at Flemington, chasing home well into third behind a potentially talented quinella. Beaten 4.5 lengths into third there is a good piece of form for this. ANORI DANCER (6) is a well-bred filly by Stay Inside who kicks off for the Nichols & Black yard. She's jumped out very well and looks ready to go. JETSETTER (2) was well behind LA LA LILLY on debut at Flemington but will be better for that experience and can improve sharply. CAHABA LAD (1) is an Alabama Express colt on debut off a jumpout win, respecting any support. MUNGER (3) next best on debut.
